faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.description: The short version: whether you need an account, what it costs, how the cleaning plan is built and what happens to your data.
faqPage.lead: The questions we get most often. If yours is missing, write to us and we will add it.
faqPage.q1: Do I need to sign up?
faqPage.a1: No. Articles, checklists and challenges are open to everyone. An account keeps your progress: habits, streak, statistics and the family plan live there.
faqPage.a2: It is free and ad-free. There are no paid tiers right now; if they appear, the core sections stay free.
faqPage.q3: How is the cleaning plan built?
faqPage.a3: You answer ten questions about your home and rhythm: the place, pets and how much time you can give to cleaning. From the answers we build a weekly plan and spread tasks across your days so a day never exceeds the time you chose.
faqPage.q4: Can I clean together with my family?
faqPage.a4: Yes. Create a home, send the invite code to your family and you get a shared plan: zones, tasks and who closed what. The home admin can hand out tasks, others take them.
faqPage.q5: What are the streak and the freeze?
faqPage.a5: A streak counts days in a row when at least one item was closed: a task, a habit or something from the plan. A freeze lets you skip a day without losing the streak, and you get two a month.
faqPage.q6: Where do the articles come from?
faqPage.a6: We write them ourselves: everyday scenarios we have tested in our own flats. No reprints and no ten miraculous hacks.
faqPage.a7: We keep only what is needed to work: your email, a password hash and your lists. The details are in the privacy policy. You can delete everything from the settings with the reset button.
faqPage.a8: Yes, if you turn notifications on in the settings. A reminder arrives when a habit is due, even with the app closed.
faqPage.a9: The app installs on your phone and opens offline, but your data — progress and plans — is loaded from the network.
faqPage.a10: Any modern browser: phone, tablet, desktop. On a phone it is handier to add the site to your home screen.

aboutPage.title: About the project
aboutPage.description: Why TidyPlan exists, what the advice is based on and how the service works.
aboutPage.lead: TidyPlan is a small project about cleaning your home without burning out: short plans, clear steps and no guilt about dust.
aboutPage.whyBody: Most cleaning apps demand discipline people do not have. We went the other way: small tasks, an honest time estimate and a plan you can actually finish on a normal day.
aboutPage.howBody: Challenges give you a day-by-day programme, checklists are ready-made lists by room, and habits cover the little things like five minutes in the kitchen. There is also a wizard: ten questions about your home, and a weekly plan is built from the answers. The family mode keeps one shared plan for several people.
aboutPage.principlesBody: No ads and no selling data. No photo reports and no surveillance: cleaning is your business, not a report. Anything that can be deleted goes away with a single button.
aboutPage.whoBody: A small team that cleans and uses the app itself. We read every question and answer by email.

contactsPage.title: Contacts
contactsPage.description: How to reach the TidyPlan team: email for questions, ideas and data requests.
contactsPage.lead: Write to us directly — we answer ourselves, without bots or canned replies.
contactsPage.supportBody: Something is broken, or you cannot tell how a tick got into your statistics — add a link and a screenshot if you can.
contactsPage.ideasBody: What is missing, what gets in the way, which article topics you need — we read everything.
contactsPage.dataBody: Deleting your account and personal data questions can be handled in the settings, but email works too.
contactsPage.note: We usually reply within two working days.

setupCard.title: Let us build a plan for your home
setupCard.text: Answer 11 short questions about rooms, pets and how much time you are ready to spend cleaning — and we will put together a weekly plan: no more than 40 minutes a day, on the days you pick.

guide.title: How to use the app
guide.lead: A short tour of what is inside and where to start. Nothing complicated: the app walks you from the first day to a habit.
guide.challengesBody: Ready-made programmes for several days: each day has its own set of tasks. Start any of them and progress is kept day by day.
guide.habitsBody: Small regular things: five minutes in the kitchen, wipe the sink. Tick them off — the app keeps your streak and reminds you when it is time.
guide.checklistsBody: Ready-made lists by room. Take a template or create your own list and tick items off as you clean.
guide.familyBody: Create a home, send the invite code to your family and run a shared plan: zones, tasks and who does what. The owner can hand out tasks; others take them.
guide.streakBody: A day counts when you close any single item. Missed a day? A freeze saves the streak. The weekly goal is how many days you want to close, and progress shows on the home screen.
guide.statsBody: Tasks, time and cleaning history for a week, a month or all time. Open it from the menu or the home screen — the numbers match everywhere.
guide.notificationsBody: Turn notifications on in the settings and a reminder about a habit or task arrives on time, even with the app closed.
